shloka_text: विसृज्य लक्ष्मणं रामो दुःखशोकसमन्वितः । पुरोधसं मन्त्रिणश्च नैगमांश्चेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.107.1 ।।
transliteration: visṛjya lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ | purodhasaṃ mantriṇaśca naigamāṃścedamabravīt || 7.107.1 ||
translation: विसृज्य having sent away, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, रामः Rama, दुःखशोकसमन्वितः filled with sorrow and grief, पुरोधसं to the chief priest, मन्त्रिणः to the ministers, च and, नैगमान् to the citizens, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Having sent Lakshmana away, Rama, filled with sorrow and grief, spoke these words to his chief priest, ministers, and citizens.
comments: Bereft of Lakshmana, Rama resolves to install Bharata and retire to the forest -- but Bharata refuses kingship without him and asks that Kusha and Lava be enthroned, while the grieving citizens beg to follow wherever Rama goes -- consenting, Rama consecrates Kusha in Kosala and Lava in the north, endows them richly, and sends messengers to summon Shatrughna.

shloka_text: अद्य राज्ये ऽभिषेक्ष्यामि भरतं धर्मवत्सलम् । अयोध्यायाः पतिं वीरं ततो यास्याम्यहं वनम् ।। 7.107.2 ।।
transliteration: adya rājye 'bhiṣekṣyāmi bharataṃ dharmavatsalam | ayodhyāyāḥ patiṃ vīraṃ tato yāsyāmyahaṃ vanam || 7.107.2 ||
translation: अद्य today, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall anoint, भरतं Bharata, धर्मवत्सलम् devoted to dharma, अयोध्यायाः of Ayodhya, पतिं the lord, वीरं the brave one, ततः then, यास्यामि I shall go, अहं I, वनम् to the forest.
explanation: Rama declared, "Today I shall install the righteous and brave Bharata as the ruler of Ayodhya, and then I myself shall go to the forest."

shloka_text: प्रवेशयत सम्भारान्माभूत्कालस्य पर्ययः । अद्यैवाहं गमिष्यामि लक्ष्मणेन गतां गतिम् ।। 7.107.3 ।।
transliteration: praveśayata sambhārānmābhūtkālasya paryayaḥ | adyaivāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇena gatāṃ gatim || 7.107.3 ||
translation: प्रवेशयत bring in, सम्भारान् preparations, मा let not, भूत् happen, कालस्य of time, पर्ययः a lapse, अद्यैव today itself, अहं I, गमिष्यामि will go, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, गतां attained, गतिम् the path.
explanation: Bring in the preparations, let there be no delay, for today itself I will follow the path that Lakshmana has taken.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं सर्वाः प्रकृतयो भृशम् । मूर्धभिः प्रणता भूमौ गतसत्त्वा इवाभवन् ।। 7.107.4 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghaveṇoktaṃ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo bhṛśam | mūrdhabhiḥ praṇatā bhūmau gatasattvā ivābhavan || 7.107.4 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवेण by Rama, उक्तं spoken, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः the subjects, भृशम् greatly, मूर्धभिः with their heads, प्रणताः bowed down, भूमौ on the ground, गतसत्त्वाः as if lifeless, इव as if, अभवन् became.
explanation: Having heard those words spoken by Rama, all the subjects greatly bowed their heads to the ground, as if they had lost their very life.

shloka_text: भरतश्च विसञ्ज्ञो ऽभूच्छ्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम् । राज्यं विगर्हयामास राघवं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.107.5 ।।
transliteration: bharataśca visañjño 'bhūcchrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam | rājyaṃ vigarhayāmāsa rāghavaṃ cedamabravīt || 7.107.5 ||
translation: भरतश्च Bharata also, विसञ्ज्ञः unconscious, अभूत् became, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्य of Rama, भाषितम् the words, राज्यं kingship, विगर्हयामास condemned, राघवं to Rama, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Bharata also became unconscious upon hearing Rama's words, and condemning kingship, he spoke these words to Rama.

shloka_text: सत्येनाहं शपे राजन्स्वर्गलोके न चैव हि । न कामये यथा राज्यं त्वां विना रघुनन्दन ।। 7.107.6 ।।
transliteration: satyenāhaṃ śape rājansvargaloke na caiva hi | na kāmaye yathā rājyaṃ tvāṃ vinā raghunandana || 7.107.6 ||
translation: सत्येन by truth, अहं I, शपे swear, राजन् O King, स्वर्गलोके in the heavenly world, न not, च and, एव indeed, हि surely, न not, कामये desire, यथा just as, राज्यं kingship, त्वां you, विना without, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O King, I swear by truth, and indeed by the heavenly world, that I do not desire kingship without you, O delight of the Raghus.

shloka_text: इमौ कुशलवौ राजन्नभिषिञ्च नराधिप । कोसलेषु कुशं वीरमुत्तरेषु तथा लवम् ।। 7.107.7 ।।
transliteration: imau kuśalavau rājannabhiṣiñca narādhipa | kosaleṣu kuśaṃ vīramuttareṣu tathā lavam || 7.107.7 ||
translation: इमौ these two, कुशलवौ Kusha and Lava, राजन् O King, अभिषिञ्च enthrone, नराधिप O lord of men, कोसलेषु in Kosala, कुशं Kusha, वीरम् the brave, उत्तरेषु in the northern regions, तथा and, लवम् Lava.
explanation: O King, O lord of men, enthrone these two, Kusha and Lava; Kusha, the brave, in Kosala, and similarly Lava in the northern regions.

shloka_text: शत्रुघ्नस्य तु गच्छन्तु दूतास्त्वरितविक्रमाः । इदं गमनमस्माकं स्वर्गायाख्यातु मा चिरम् ।। 7.107.8 ।।
transliteration: śatrughnasya tu gacchantu dūtāstvaritavikramāḥ | idaṃ gamanamasmākaṃ svargāyākhyātu mā ciram || 7.107.8 ||
translation: शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, तु and, गच्छन्तु let them go, दूताः messengers, त्वरितविक्रमाः swift-footed, इदं this, गमनम् departure, अस्माकं our, स्वर्गाय for heaven, आख्यातु let them announce, मा not, चिरम् long.
explanation: Let swift messengers go to Shatrughna and without delay inform him of our departure to heaven.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतेनोक्तं दृष्ट्वा चापि ह्यधोमुखान् । पौरान्दुःखेन सन्तप्तान्वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। 7.107.9 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā bharatenoktaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāpi hyadhomukhān | paurānduḥkhena santaptānvasiṣṭho vākyamabravīt || 7.107.9 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, भरतेन by Bharata, उक्तं spoken, दृष्ट्वा having seen, च and, अपि also, अधोमुखान् downcast, पौरान् citizens, दुःखेन by sorrow, सन्तप्तान् distressed, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard what Bharata said and seeing the citizens distressed and downcast with sorrow, Vasishtha spoke these words.

shloka_text: वत्स राम इमाः पश्य धरणीं प्रकृतीर्गताः । ज्ञात्वैषामीप्सितं कार्यं मा चैषां विप्रियं कृथाः ।। 7.107.10 ।।
transliteration: vatsa rāma imāḥ paśya dharaṇīṃ prakṛtīrgatāḥ | jñātvaiṣāmīpsitaṃ kāryaṃ mā caiṣāṃ vipriyaṃ kṛthāḥ || 7.107.10 ||
translation: वत्स dear son, राम Rama, इमाः these, पश्य behold, धरणीं to the ground, प्रकृतीः subjects, गताः fallen, ज्ञात्वा having known, एषां their, ईप्सितं desired, कार्यं action, मा not, च and, एषां their, विप्रियं displeasure, कृथाः cause.
explanation: Vasishtha said, "Dear Rama, behold these subjects fallen to the ground; understanding their desire, do not cause them any displeasure."

shloka_text: वसिष्ठस्य तु वाक्येन उत्थाप्य प्रकृतीजनम् । किं करोमीति काकुत्स्थः सर्वा वचनमब्रवीत् ।। 7.107.11 ।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhasya tu vākyena utthāpya prakṛtījanam | kiṃ karomīti kākutsthaḥ sarvā vacanamabravīt || 7.107.11 ||
translation: वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, तु and, वाक्येन by the words, उत्थाप्य having raised up, प्रकृतीजनम् the people, किं what, करोमि shall I do, इति thus, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), सर्वाः to all, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: And by the words of Vasishtha, Rama, having raised up the people, spoke to all, asking, "What shall I do?"

shloka_text: ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो रामं वचनमब्रुवन् । गच्छन्तमनुगच्छामो यत्र राम गमिष्यसि ।। 7.107.12 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo rāmaṃ vacanamabruvan | gacchantamanugacchāmo yatra rāma gamiṣyasi || 7.107.12 ||
translation: ततः then, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः subjects, रामं to Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रुवन् spoke, गच्छन्तम् one who is going, अनुगच्छामः we will follow, यत्र where, राम Rama, गमिष्यसि you will go.
explanation: Then all the subjects spoke to Rama, saying, "We will follow you, wherever you, Rama, will go."

shloka_text: पौरेषु यदि ते प्रीतिर्यदि स्नेहो ह्यनुत्तमः । सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थ समागच्छाम सत्पथम् ।। 7.107.13 ।।
transliteration: paureṣu yadi te prītiryadi sneho hyanuttamaḥ | saputradārāḥ kākutstha samāgacchāma satpatham || 7.107.13 ||
translation: पौरेषु towards the citizens, यदि if, ते your, प्रीतिः affection, यदि if, स्नेहः love, हि indeed, अनुत्तमः unsurpassed, सपुत्रदाराः with children and wives, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, समागच्छाम let us go together, सत्पथम् on the righteous path.
explanation: O Rama, if you truly have unsurpassed affection and love for your citizens, then let us all, with our children and wives, accompany you on your path.

shloka_text: तपोवनं वा दुर्गं वा नदीमम्भोनिधिं तथा । वयं ते यदि न त्याज्याः सर्वान्नो नय ईश्वर ।। 7.107.14 ।।
transliteration: tapovanaṃ vā durgaṃ vā nadīmambhonidhiṃ tathā | vayaṃ te yadi na tyājyāḥ sarvānno naya īśvara || 7.107.14 ||
translation: तपोवनम् to the hermitage, वा or, दुर्गम् to a fortress, वा or, नदीम् to a river, अम्भोनिधिम् to the ocean, तथा similarly, वयम् we, ते by you, यदि if, न not, त्याज्याः to be abandoned, सर्वान् all, नः us, नय lead, ईश्वर O Lord.
explanation: O Lord, if we are not to be abandoned by you, then lead all of us, whether to a hermitage, a fortress, a river, or the ocean.

shloka_text: एषा नः परमा प्रीतिरेष नः परमो वरः । हृद्गता नः सदा प्रीतिस्तवानुगमने नृप ।। 7.107.15 ।।
transliteration: eṣā naḥ paramā prītireṣa naḥ paramo varaḥ | hṛdgatā naḥ sadā prītistavānugamane nṛpa || 7.107.15 ||
translation: एषा this, नः our, परमा supreme, प्रीतिः affection, एषः this, नः our, परमः supreme, वरः boon, हृद्गता residing in the heart, नः our, सदा always, प्रीतिः affection, तव your, अनुगमने in following, नृप O King.
explanation: O King, this is our supreme affection and our greatest wish, for our hearts are always filled with love for following you.

shloka_text: पौराणां दृढभक्तिं च बाढमित्येव सो ऽब्रवीत् । स्वकृतान्तं चान्ववेक्ष्य तस्मिन्नहनि राघवः ।। 7.107.16 ।।
transliteration: paurāṇāṃ dṛḍhabhaktiṃ ca bāḍhamityeva so 'bravīt | svakṛtāntaṃ cānvavekṣya tasminnahani rāghavaḥ || 7.107.16 ||
translation: पौराणाम् of the citizens, दृढभक्तिम् firm devotion, च and, बाढम् certainly, इति thus, एव indeed, सः he, अब्रवीत् said, स्वकृतान्तम् his own destiny, च and, अन्ववेक्ष्य having considered, तस्मिन् on that, अहनि day, राघवः Rama.
explanation: Having observed the firm devotion of the citizens and considering his own destined end, Rama said, "Certainly, yes," on that very day.

shloka_text: कोसलेषु कुशं वीरमुत्तरेषु तथा लवम् । अभिषिच्य महात्मानावुभौ रामः कुशीलवौ ।। 7.107.17 ।।
transliteration: kosaleṣu kuśaṃ vīramuttareṣu tathā lavam | abhiṣicya mahātmānāvubhau rāmaḥ kuśīlavau || 7.107.17 ||
translation: कोसलेषु in Kosala, कुशम् Kusha, वीरम् the brave, उत्तरेषु in the northern regions, तथा similarly, लवम् Lava, अभिषिच्य having consecrated, महात्मानौ the two great-souled ones, उभौ both, रामः Rama, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava.
explanation: Rama, having consecrated both the brave and great-souled Kusha in Kosala and similarly Lava in the northern regions, completed his arrangements.

shloka_text: अभिषिक्तौ सुतावङ्के प्रतिष्ठाप्य पुरे ततः । परिष्वज्य महाबाहुर्मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय चासकृत् ।। 7.107.18 ।।
transliteration: abhiṣiktau sutāvaṅke pratiṣṭhāpya pure tataḥ | pariṣvajya mahābāhurmūrdhnyupāghrāya cāsakṛt || 7.107.18 ||
translation: अभिषिक्तौ having been consecrated, सुतौ sons, अङ्के on his lap, प्रतिष्ठाप्य having established, पुरे in the city, ततः then, परिष्वज्य having embraced, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, मूर्ध्नि on the head, उपाघ्राय having smelled, च and, असकृत् repeatedly.
explanation: Then, the mighty-armed Rama, having consecrated his two sons and established them in the city, repeatedly embraced them and kissed them on their heads.

shloka_text: रथानां तु सहस्राणि नागानामयुतानि च । दशायुतानि चाश्वानामेकैकस्य धनं ददौ ।। 7.107.19 ।।
transliteration: rathānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi nāgānāmayutāni ca | daśāyutāni cāśvānāmekaikasya dhanaṃ dadau || 7.107.19 ||
translation: रथानाम् of chariots, तु indeed, सहस्राणि thousands, नागानाम् of elephants, अयुतानि ten thousands, च and, दशायुतानि ten ten-thousands, च and, अश्वानाम् of horses, एकैकस्य to each one, धनम् wealth, ददौ he gave.
explanation: He gave to each of his sons thousands of chariots, ten thousands of elephants, and one hundred thousand horses as wealth.

shloka_text: बहुरत्नौ बहुधनौ हृष्टपुष्टजनावृतौ । स्वे पुरे प्रेषयामास भ्रातरौ तु कुशीलवौ ।। 7.107.20 ।।
transliteration: bahuratnau bahudhanau hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtau | sve pure preṣayāmāsa bhrātarau tu kuśīlavau || 7.107.20 ||
translation: बहुरत्नौ having many jewels, बहुधनौ having much wealth, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृतौ surrounded by happy and well-nourished people, स्वे to their own, पुरे city, प्रेषयामास he sent, भ्रातरौ the two brothers, तु indeed, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava.
explanation: He then sent the two brothers, Kusha and Lava, to their respective cities, each endowed with many jewels, much wealth, and surrounded by happy and prosperous people.

shloka_text: अभिषिच्य सुतौ वीरौ प्रतिष्ठाप्य पुरे तदा । दूतान्सम्प्रेषयामास शत्रुघ्नाय महात्मने ।। 7.107.21 ।।
transliteration: abhiṣicya sutau vīrau pratiṣṭhāpya pure tadā | dūtānsampreṣayāmāsa śatrughnāya mahātmane || 7.107.21 ||
translation: अभिषिच्य having consecrated, सुतौ sons, वीरौ heroic, प्रतिष्ठाप्य having established, पुरे in the city, तदा then, दूतान् messengers, सम्प्रेषयामास he sent, शत्रुघ्नाय to Shatrughna, महात्मने the great-souled one.
explanation: After consecrating his heroic sons and establishing them in their cities, he then dispatched messengers to the great-souled Shatrughna. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 107 ।। Thus ends the hundred and seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
